input.free_text_description: This system is an user management platform that serves Developer, Admin roles. It exposes interfaces for managing ignore shop, shop, user. Secondary concerns include e-commerce functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Developer, I want to interact with ignore shop functionality, so that I can accomplish my ignore shop-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to interact with shop functionality, so that I can accomplish my shop-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to interact with goods functionality, so that I can accomplish my goods-related tasks.
As a Developer, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
